kind: Mutation check of checks/preview_tests.cjs (independent review round)
method: Each mutant changes one or two lines of blobs.frag in a scratch copy of the study; the full preview test suite runs on it. A mutant is caught when at least one test fails.
origin: Mutants from the independent reviewer M (lens_sign_flip, no_exit_refraction, normal_toWorld, absorption_ignores_path, chord_unrefracted, depth_gl_convention, smin_shrinks), adapted to the current code. Their eighth mutant (ortho_eye_flipped) targets code that no longer exists.

mutants.change: Normals and exit normals transformed with toWorld instead of the inverse transpose
screenShift() returns origin minus target (the refraction shift flipped)
absorption() uses a path of 1 instead of the measured path
the interior march follows the camera ray instead of the refracted ray
depth remapped as if clip z were -1..1 (OpenGL convention)
smooth minimum adds the blend term instead of subtracting it

scope: WebGL2 SwiftShader preview; shows the tests can fail for these defects, not that every defect is caught.
